bias: IEX is a single venue with a small share of consolidated volume, so these quoted spreads are WIDER than the true NBBO. Every cost here is an overstatement, which makes it a conservative cost test.
caveats: quoted spread only -- market impact is NOT measured or included.
regular session only; the open and close auctions, which are the widest part of the day, are excluded.
one sampled session per month -- this is a per-symbol LEVEL, not a daily time series, and it does not capture stress days. Use half_p90 for a stress-aware figure.
free plan = IEX feed; spreads read wider than consolidated NBBO.
